title.en: For good in this world and the next

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāban-nār

title.en: Before speaking or a hard task

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-raḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī waḥlul ʿuqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa'nā

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnī ʿilmā

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbunallāhu wa niʿmal-wakīl

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wajʿalnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā

title.en: In distress — the du'a of Yunus

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samīʿud-duʿā'

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subḥānalladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik

translations.en: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik

translations.en: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika-llāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā

translations.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhilladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr

translations.en: Praise belongs to Allah, who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa ḍalaʿid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl

translations.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You from worry and from grief, from incapacity and from idleness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from the weight of debt and from being overpowered by others.

duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.transliteration: As'alullāhal-ʿaẓīma rabbal-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīmi an yashfiyak

translations.en: I ask Allah the Immense, Lord of the Immense Throne, to heal you.

title.en: On hearing of a death or loss

duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn, Allāhumma'jurnī fī muṣībatī wa akhlif lī khayran minhā

translations.en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in this affliction of mine, and give me in its place something better than it.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mas-taṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū'u laka biniʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abū'u bidhanbī faghfir lī fa innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant

translations.en: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as far as I am able. I take refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin — so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlā, wa anta tajʿalul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā

translations.en: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and when You will, You make hardship itself easy.
